scope: Q003-Q005 personal boss instancing; cooperative ordinary hunting/LAN/other activities remain required, not replaced by this solo mainline trial
entry_policy: explicit marker interaction, living/idle/out of combat/no active activity; exact quest boss stage. Validate complete target scene/actor/resource/return anchor before committing. No recharge/heal/refresh buffs or skill timers. Reject invalid entry without teleport or charge.
boss_spawn_policy: remove three story boss actors from shared ordinary world; preserve IDs/coordinates only inside encounter instance. Never let public-world stale boss events grant quest/loot.
gate_policy: public challenge_gate remains solid; explicit outside marker opens eligible personal encounter, instance challenge_gate collision opens there only. Never toggle room-wide collision from one character quest. Other private geometry preserved; no looping public portal trigger.
failure: player death or confirmed abandon -> failed attempt; no monster/quest reward or refund. Death uses normal story_workcamp_start respawn; living abandon returns owning public anchor with actual resources/cooldowns. New retry fresh boss under new attempt ID, never restarts old saved attempt.
victory: authoritative terminal boss death snapshots reward/credit exactly once, marks personal boss objective complete, commits monster XP/practice and receipt, enters victory_reward_pending. No second death/respawn/XP. Remove combat threats; remaining committed player status/cooldowns follow normal rules.
fixed_loot_claim: explicit persistent encounter reward panel, one entry per actual fixed-loot line; all-or-nothing claim validates bag slots/weight and then produces items/new stack IDs once. Claim does not repeat XP/practice/quest objective. Full bag keeps reward pending; no silent inventory/mail/warehouse drop.
exit_with_pending: explicit confirmation can return with persistent pending reward entitlement. Claim later at Cao service; pending reward not carried item/weight and not quest material. No extra monster spawn to reclaim; final quest turn-in may proceed independently, pending receipt remains claimable until actual claim.
ordinary_drop_policy_difference: these personal boss fixed rewards use durable entitlement, not ordinary transient ground drops; explicit project change prevents losing unique boss ore/potions on save/exit. Ordinary monster and gather drops keep existing field rules.
replay_policy: death receipt per character/quest objective; reward claim receipt per death result; old acknowledged role revisions and duplicate requests return original or stale error, never issue a new attempt or reward
persistence: combat retains full same instance/boss/resources/actions/projectiles/random/status and attempt. After terminal victory may release combat scene but persists death/XP receipt and fixed reward entitlement/claimed state; always validates state transitions and target definitions. LAN host journal plus character ack protocol required.
import_policy: old quest return/report/completed state proves objective already defeated but not unpicked loot entitlement; do not invent pending ore/potions, new XP or a second boss. Preserve known actual old inventory and task progress. Exact old instance-ID/schema migration remains separate required work.
